oushii.midnightconfig.title: Oushii Config
oushii.midnightconfig.maxExplosionPartic: Hard-cap on explosion particles spawned per tick to protect client FPS.
oushii.midnightconfig.maxRenderedTnt.too: Maximum TNT entities rendered on screen simultaneously.
oushii.midnightconfig.maxPrimedPerExplos: Limit primed TNT spawned per explosion to prevent entity cascades.
oushii.midnightconfig.clusterRadius.tool: Radius in blocks within which same-tick explosions merge into a single blast.
